content:
If aliens ever come knocking, you might want to have more than a tin foil hat ready.

A Florida UFO researcher has made the rather extraordinary claim that there is one surprisingly simple way to stop an alleged alien abduction… calling on Jesus.

Joe Jordan has spent decades investigating UFO and alleged alien abduction reports, claiming he has looked into hundreds of cases.

According to Jordan, some people who reported being abducted said the experience suddenly stopped after they called out to Jesus or God.

And apparently, that discovery sent his research in a very unexpected direction.

From UFOs To Faith

Jordan says his investigations eventually led him to become a Christian, and his research group focuses heavily on the idea that some alleged alien encounters could have a spiritual explanation.

His organisation, the CE4 Research Group, says it has worked with hundreds of alleged alien abduction cases.

But before anyone starts cancelling their next trip to Roswell, there is a pretty important catch.

There’s A Lot Of Debate

Jordan’s interpretation is highly controversial, with sceptics offering alternative explanations for reported abduction experiences, including sleep paralysis and other psychological phenomena.

Still, if aliens do eventually arrive, forget calling 000… just drop Jesus’ name and apparently they should leave you alone.
